title: Coupon stacking
skill: Spell out the order of operations

good: In src/coupons/apply.js, applyCoupons({ items, shipping }, coupons) applies coupons in list order, stacks every percent coupon, lets amounts go below 0, and takes shipping coupons off items. Rules, all in cents: use only the percent coupon with the highest value, applied first to items, discount = Math.round(items * value / 100); then subtract every fixed coupon from items; items never below 0, and extra fixed discount does not touch shipping; shipping coupons subtract only from shipping, never below 0; total = items + shipping; the list order must not change the result. Keep the return shape { items, shipping, total }. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Coupon totals are wrong when people use more than one coupon. Fix it.
